questions.prompt: The agent is in step 2 of a turn when you send a steer. What happens to it?
options: It waits until the turn ends and then starts a new turn
It is claimed before the next model request in the same turn and logged as a user message
It is sent straight to the model without being logged
It cancels the current step and restarts the turn
questions.explanation: A steer goes to the next-step tray, which is claimed before every later step. Like every claimed message it is appended as a user/message event, so the model sees it in the next request of the same turn.

questions.prompt: The model answers in plain text, but a steer arrived while that last request was streaming. What should the turn do?
options: End the turn and drop the steer
End the turn and leave the steer for the next turn's request
Take one more step so the model can read the steer
Turn the steer into a followup automatically
questions.explanation: A turn may only end when the model answered in plain text and the next-step tray is empty. A waiting steer means one more step.

questions.prompt: Why does inject not wake the agent?
options: It is meant to ride along with whatever request happens next, not to start work on its own
Inject only works while the agent is idle
Injected messages go to the next-turn tray
questions.explanation: Inject adds to the next-step tray without calling wake. The note lands in the next request that happens for some other reason.
